_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Intego yanjye ni kushyira ukwezi mu myanya itatu muri row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) kuri kibanza.
Mu gihe cy'ukwezi, unahitaji kubera nomero y'ikibanza (0-8) wakora ukwezi wawe.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' ikora ukwezi mu kibanza kijyewe cha kibanza.
Njye Umukino {player_id}, uzoba '{symbol}', wewe na umukinnyi wawe uzoba '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ntabwo ari inganda yemewe. Bigomba kuba biri hagati ya 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Umukino {player_id} waje gukora ikitego ({symbol}) mu kibanza {cell}.

outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa!
